name: CardNav-TS-TW
title: CardNav
description: A slim dark navbar holds a centred logo, a hamburger and a light Get Started button. Tapping the menu drops the bar open into three tinted cards, each listing nested links with small arrows.
use: A premium studio site needs a compact header that reveals grouped links on demand.
avoid: Sites with many link groups: only the first three item sets are ever rendered.
a11y: The toggle is a div with role button and no key handler, so the menu cannot be opened from the keyboard; no focus styles. (keyboard: no, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A narrow dark rounded bar sits at the top centre of a black page, with a white logo centred, a small light Get Started button on the right and a two-line hamburger on the left. Open, three deep violet cards fill the bar with tinted labels and arrowed links.
behaves: Tapping the hamburger unfolds the bar downward while three cards fade and rise into place one after another. Tapping again folds the bar back to its slim resting height.
customise: Logo, item groups with their own colours and links, ease, base colour, menu colour and button colours are props. Card count is capped at three in the source.
weight: light: One height tween and three card fades; nothing loops.
demo: Logo "Northwind"; page headline "Design studio for ambitious products"; cards About, Projects and Contact.
issues: Item groups past the first three are dropped, because the source slices the list to three.
polishWhy: Tidy dark bar and clean cards; the demo subline sits very close under the heading.
